H_hierarchical.evidence: The controller is organized as a main program that conditionally invokes subprograms for device polling, thermoknife motion, quality control, and temperature recording.

G_guards_arith.evidence: Guards include no-emergency calls, shutter-closed before hopper filling, hopper-filled before sealing, package-present before weighing, and weight mismatch before ejection.

A_actions_nontrivial.evidence: Actions command multiple actuators: start screw feeder/conveyor, stop vibrating tray, open shutter, move thermoknives, eject package, stop all processes on fault.

F_fault_recovery.evidence: On any emergency, all working processes stop, the system enters waiting mode, and resumes only after operator fault reset.

T1_cross_section_element.evidence: Process actions are described in the equipment/process section, while subprogram structure, guards, and fault behavior are described later in the main-program section.

T2_implicit_domain_term.evidence: Terms such as emergency stop, аварийная ситуация, режим ожидания, and сброс аварии imply fail-safe stop and reset semantics.

T3_implicit_action_from_prose.evidence: Actions for feeder, shutter, thermoknives, conveyor, quality control, and pusher are given in narrative prose rather than a state/action table.

T4_multivar_arith_guard.evidence: Quality control combines package presence with comparison of measured weight against the required weight before pneumatic ejection.

T5_composite_internal_behavior.evidence: The parent main program has its own behavior: it calls every subprogram only when no emergency is present, while feeder and conveyor run continuously after Start.

T6_global_cross_cutting_recovery.evidence: The paper states that when an emergency occurs, all working processes stop and the system switches to waiting mode.

C1_speculative_dfs.evidence: There is a shallow composite supervisor-to-subprogram structure, but no deep pseudo-state initialization chain is specified.

C2_expr_ir_smt.evidence: There are 1-2 meaningful composed guards, especially package-present plus weight-mismatch and no-emergency gating of subprogram calls.

C3_forced_and_aspect.evidence: The emergency rule applies across multiple machine subprocesses, and normal operation has parent-level continuous feeder/conveyor behavior.

C4_abstract_action.evidence: Most effects are concrete actuator commands, but temperature recording and emergency signaling are abstract side effects without a fixed channel.

key_nl_quotes: В основной программе производится вызов каждой подпрограммы при условии отсутствия аварийной ситуации.
В случае возникновения аварийной ситуации все рабочие процессы останавливаются, и система переходит в режим ожидания.
one_line_pitch: This sample stresses weak baseline action, guard, hierarchy, and global-recovery handling through a PLC supervisor whose behavior is scattered across process prose, subprogram structure, and fault semantics.
rationale: The paper provides a concrete industrial controller with a main supervisor, nested subprocesses, guarded actuator sequencing, quality-control checks, and explicit global emergency recovery. Its information is not presented as a clean state table, so an LLM-to-SMF baseline must infer state/action attribution and duplicate cross-cutting fault behavior. The combination of BD=3 and FT=3 makes it a strong top-15 stress-test candidate.
